name: graphql-composable-sdl-schema-extensions
instr:
graphql-go/graphql cannot currently parse and atomically apply composable SDL extensions to an executable schema. Implement this while keeping existing schema behavior and compatibility unchanged. Successful extensions must act like native definitions in validation, planning, execution, traversal, lookup, and printing.

Preserve family-specific structure, source information, descriptions, directives, constants, and source-ordered children. Malformed input returns an error and no usable document. Generic traversal visits each semantic extension child exactly once without changing ordinary AST traversal order. Programmatic construction keeps nil-input behavior, absent-versus-present groups, independent definition value semantics, and StringValue descriptions.

Coerce defaults against runtime input types. Preserve omitted, null, and explicit values in nested lists and input objects. Apply documents atomically, enforcing family constraints for objects, interfaces, unions, enums, inputs, scalars, and schema roots. Any failure leaves every observable schema view unchanged.

A successful commit retains field callbacks and metadata while publishing one coherent snapshot to type lookup, abstract relationships, ValidateDocument, new plans, Execute, Do, and schema printing. Existing plans remain safe, keep their schema-bound interpretation during concurrent commits, and never observe mixed schema states.
